text_block_list.text:
After training for the day, Biwa
Hayahide and I
start tidying up when
someone catches her
attention...

Hm? Taishin! Are you done for the day
too?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm just taking a break. I still have a little
more to
do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious. It's already dark.
Resting up
for the next day is just as
important as—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone. I don't need your
nagging. I
know what I'm doing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The nerve! As her friend and rival, how
can I just
leave her be?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm worried about Taishin.
Would it be all
right if I train with her for
a while?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in your rival.

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm worried about Taishin.
Would it be all
right if I train with her for
a while?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You should have more faith in your rival.

text_block_list.text: Thank you! I really appreciate it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Taishin! Hold on!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You wanna train together? Why? Didn't
you just
say you were done for the day?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Watching you made me want to run
more myself.
Please, can't I join you?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...Okay, fine. It's not like you'll take no
for an
answer, anyway.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Don't blame me if you're tired tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hm... I guess you're right.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's not like we can both come
in first
place. All of us are training to
win.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The best thing I can do is go home and
take care
of myself, then.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I have to be in top condition to compete
with her,
after all!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
With that, Бива Хаяхидэ watches her
rival go off
to train alone as she returns
to her dorm.

They spend the evening training
together until
just before curfew.
